text: GLFW からの独立の機運が徐々に高まってくる
Linux のホイールがスムースになったのは 2011 年からのことで (<https://github.com/glfw/glfw/issues/1376>) しかもこれは GLFW に未だに実装されてないんですね…

attachments.title: <https://github.com/glfw/glfw/issues/1376|#1376 Implement smooth scrolling for X11>
attachments.text:
Right now scrolling for X11 is handled via Button4 / Button5 key presses, which is very rough.

<https://github.com/glfw/glfw/blob/53c8c72c676ca97c10aedfe3d0eb4271c5b23dba/src/x11_window.c#L1395|glfw/src/x11_window.c>

Line 1395 in </glfw/glfw/commit/53c8c72c676ca97c10aedfe3d0eb4271c5b23dba|53c8c72>

The comment above is not true since 2011, when X11 implemented a <https://who-t.blogspot.com/2011/09/whats-new-in-xi-21-smooth-scrolling.html|smooth scrolling>, which allows pixel-precise control. It really makes a _huge_ difference, please support it too.

You might find interesting corresponding issues for <https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=384970|Chromium> and <https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=958868|Firefox>, both implemented this long time ago, I simply was using these browsers to compare the behavior to a glfw-based app until I figured out where the problem is.

Cross-linking the issues: <https://github.com/kovidgoyal/kitty/issues/1123|kovidgoyal/kitty#1123>
